headline: Discussed budget timeline, board budget guidance, facilities master plan, facilities use procedure, and commissioner stipend.
summary: The committee reviewed the budget timeline, including a new September department budget review process. It discussed board budget guidance, updates on the facilities master plan using BSD condition data and NESDEC data, a new facilities use and rental procedure for external groups, and the need to formalize a commissioner stipend procedure.
plain_text:
BSD Finance & Facilities Committee Meeting Minutes 
Tuesday, September 1, 2026 at 5:00 PM 
Hunt Middle School - Library 1364 North Avenue 
Commissioners Present: Kendra Sowers 
Staff Present: Nathan Lavery 
Guests: None 
 
 
1. Opening  
A. Call meeting to order 
5:05pm  
B. Suspend Robert's Rules 
 
2. Public Comment 
None 
 
3. Discussion  
A. Budget Timeline 
Reviewed budget timeline. The only thing that has changed since last year was that each 
department will provide a budget review to the Superintendent’s Dept. in September. 
This is a new procedure and will help guide the budget decisions.  
We ramp up in September, verify enrollment at the schools, and think about what items 
need to be budgeted based on our strategic plan. 
New Board members should expect an outreach from Dir. Lavery re: Budget 101 
Education.   
B. Board Budget Guidance 
Reviewed the guidance the board provided last year to BSD. As a board, what are our 
priorities with this budget?  
October F & F meeting: Board robust discussion and give the District a good idea of what 
we want.  
Nov: Approval of budget guidance, subject always to change based on State budget 
details. 
Dec: Key variables from the state. So if we need to update we can.  
C. Facilities Master Plan Update 
We have 2 major sources of useful data coming in:  
1) BSD condition data from all of our schools.  
����������� 
Draft
2) NESDEC data: within the next 2 months we will have the long term enrollment 
projection data, a summary of current facility use, and options for optimal use of our 
facilities.  
We will then use all of this data to write a master facilities plan that states what our vision 
is for all of our schools.  
The state has created a grant to hire a facilitator for this work, so we will apply for that.   
D. Facilities Use Procedure Update 
Driven largely by the new BHS/BTC building and the ability for outside groups to use our 
facilities. This is the living, revised district procedure for use and rental by external groups. 
We are already experiencing an uptick in demand given our new school. In developing this 
new procedure, BSD did comparative analysis for rental rates. The goal is to get this into 
place ASAP and to create online website access. All the new requests will be channeled 
through property services. Responsible for staffing those different areas.   
E. Commissioner Stipend 
Discussed the need to formalize our approach and BSD will provide a formal procedure 
within the next 2 weeks.  
 
4. Adjournment 
5:55PM
